RESOURCE_GRAPH_OBJECT.closure_semantics: Expand requested resource through parents, explicit_conflicts, and semantic_umbrellas repeatedly to fixed point; sort canonical resource IDs by UTF-8 byte order; acquisition is all-or-abort.

construction_policy.file_denominator: Every Git blob in exact target tree becomes one FILE node.
construction_policy.module_parent: Deterministic path-based module grouping; FILE nodes always have exactly one MODULE parent.
construction_policy.typed_semantics: API only for app/api/**/route.*, SCHEMA only for *.prisma, CONTRACT only tests/contract/**, STATE_MACHINE only explicit state-machine/state_matrix/fsm path token, PROTOCOL only explicit protocol path token, DATABASE prisma umbrella for prisma/**, RUNTIME deployment/daemon only for explicit runtime paths.
construction_policy.cross_module_conflicts: No unproven cross-module semantic conflict is invented. Candidate remains NOT_ACTIVATION_READY until independent semantic review either proves sufficiency or adds conservative umbrellas/conflicts.
construction_policy.safety_posture: Structural inventory is exhaustive for target blobs; semantic conflict inventory is deliberately fail-closed as pending review.

CANONICALIZATION: RFC8785/JCS-equivalent for this data class; nodes sorted by canonical id and relation arrays sorted.
AUTHORITY_LIMIT: Exact target-tree enumeration proves structural presence only. Historical, future, experimental, test, docs, and other repository surfaces are not automatically current-build resource authority.
REQUIRED_PROMOTION_INPUTS: verified mapping from active obligations to current implementation resources

INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.CONCRETE_FALSE_NEGATIVE: FILE:core-kernel/Cargo.toml and FILE:core-kernel/src/lib.rs have disjoint lock closures despite same Rust crate semantic boundary.
